title: `log:` without a `run:` validates and does nothing, and check.md and test.md say `log: false` runs a shipped option unsealed
body:
FOUND 2026-09-23 by 0115's page agent for `db`, and driven again by cc at 4c9d5a7.

WHAT HAPPENS. Validation accepts `log:` at command level and under options (lib/config:441, :445). run_option reads it only inside its `if cfg_has "$run_key"` branch (lib/resolve:714-817). An option with no `run:` of its own falls through to devbin's handler (:819), which seals under the catalogue's suffix whatever the key says. run_command reads `commands.<cmd>.log` at :906, and only reaches it for a command devbin does not implement: exec_handler has already taken any command with a handler in lib/cmd/ (:892). So `log:` acts wherever devbin runs a command line, config's or the catalogue's, and is silently ignored wherever devbin's own handler runs.

DRIVEN:
- `commands.db.options.migrate.log: false`, alone. doctor says the config "parses and validates", and `bin/devbin db migrate` still sealed DBMIGRATE: the dated .out and .errors, and both LATEST_ links.
- `commands.server.log: true`, alone. `bin/devbin server` ran devbin's handler and wrote nothing under tmp/.

AND TWO SHIPPED PAGES SAY THE OPPOSITE. They were written by cc in 0113 (719e8a1). check.md:50 and test.md:47 say "`log: false` runs a shipped option unsealed". That is true only beside a `run:` of the option's own, which is how the reference config scopes it (lib/config.reference.yaml:436-439, DECLINING A SEAL). A reader who follows the page gets a key that validates and does nothing, which is the silence No Silent Errors forbids.

WHAT A FIX MUST DO. The build takes one of two paths and says why:
- make `log:` mean the same with or without a `run:`: a shipped option told `log: false` runs unsealed, and a command devbin implements told `log: true` seals;
- or refuse the key where it cannot act: validation and doctor name a `log:` with no `run:` beside it, at option level, and at command level on a command devbin implements.

Either way, check.md:50 and test.md:47 change in the same commit to say what ships. It ships in 0.1.8 under hv's ruling. cc's.

## Resolution

Fixed at 97db2d5. Ships in 0.1.8.

- WHAT CHANGED. The path the issue offered first: refuse where the key cannot act, rather than make it act everywhere, as cc designed it on 2026-09-23. doctor's check_log_keys FAILS every `log:` that nothing reads and names what runs instead, per shape: devbin's own option sealing under its catalogue suffix, devbin's own command, the project's handler, a command-level run: running the option under the command's own log:, or nothing. Whether a run reads a key is command_tier's and option_run_tier's answer (0128), so doctor cannot call a key dead that a run reads. It counts at zero, so a pass is never silence. check.md and test.md now say `log: false` beside a run: of the option's own runs it unsealed, that `log:` alone changes nothing, and that doctor fails it; doctor.md, the reference config and docs/authoring-commands.md say where `log:` is read. MEASURED on 2026-09-24: all 60 `log:` keys across the 17 estates are read, so no estate turns red.
- NOT CHANGED, ON THE RECORD. `log:` is not made to act on a command devbin implements or on a shipped option: sealing a long-running process such as server would buffer the output a developer watches, and honouring an option-level key on a shipped option would need new plumbing into gatecmd for a key `log:` beside a run: already serves.
- REVIEWS. vc's review: vc, 2026-09-25, approved on cc's design as written and on the arms, red first and mutants below.
- RED FIRST AND MUTANTS. Both arms in doctor.bats (three dead shapes beside one live key, and three live shapes as the control) red over 0128 v3 without this change, for their reasons: doctor passed where it must fail, and no `log:` count was printed. 8 mutants (P01 to P08), each against the two arms: 8 of 8 killed.
- THE SUITE. All of tests/unit over the nine 0.1.8 changes stacked in landing order on b10dd41 (0139, 0128, 0133, 0130, 0142, 0143, 0144, 0146, 0147), on a clean checkout (head 308cf21), 2026-09-25 11:34:20Z to 12:09:20Z: 1907 of 1907 ok, 0 not ok, no gaps, its 5 skips the suite's declared ones. Main after the landing is byte-identical to that tree outside intent/.
